suites.name: D0G_01
suites.title: d0 Generation Audit
suites.finding: d0 is fundamental. Survives d2 removal (1.75σ). km/lambda at 1.71σ are same structural quantity (r=-0.94).

suites.name: SKL_01
suites.title: Structural Kernel Layer Audit
suites.finding: km is more fundamental than d0. km retains 0.73σ after d0 removal; d0 retains only 0.06σ. km-λ r=0.9998 (single kernel).

suites.name: KMG_01
suites.title: Kernel Generation Audit
suites.finding: km is FUNDAMENTAL. Survives all predecessor removal (1.67σ after DL). No predecessor outperforms. Bottom of SAC chain reached.

finalModel: km (coupling matrix mean) is the fundamental structural variable. d0 and lambda are derived from km. km survives all predecessor removal. The structural kernel is the coupling matrix after 3-epoch SAC evolution.
